fit.summary: Licensed journeyman with motor control and three-phase service work in food plants.

bullets.text: Troubleshoot motor controls and 480V three-phase equipment on service calls at food plants and warehouses

cover_letter.hook: Keeping 9 packaging lines running around the clock is the kind of work I want to do full time.
cover_letter.body:
At Brightline Electric I troubleshoot motor controls and 480V three-phase service calls at food plants and warehouses. I have wired 14 commercial tenant build-outs with no failed inspections, and I led a 3-person crew on a 40,000 sq ft LED retrofit that finished 2 weeks early.

I hold a Journeyman Electrician License and finished 8,000 hours of supervised field work as an apprentice.
cover_letter.close: I would like to hear how your maintenance team splits planned work and breakdowns.

gaps: PLC troubleshooting is listed as a plus; Maria has not claimed it.
